mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO agent_session (platform, bot_id, group_id, persona_id, lifecycle, window_level) VALUES ( #{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{personaId}, #{lifecycle}, #{windowLevel} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, persona_id AS personaId, lifecycle, window_level AS windowLevel, emotion, summary_entry_id AS summaryEntryId, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM agent_session WHERE platform = #{platform} AND bot_id = #{botId} AND group_id = #{groupId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO transcript_entry (id, session_id, platform, bot_id, group_id, kind, payload, weight, occurred_at, run_id) VALUES
(#{entry.id}, #{entry.sessionId}, #{entry.platform}, #{entry.botId}, #{entry.groupId}, #{entry.kind}, #{entry.payload}, #{entry.weight}, #{entry.occurredAt}, #{entry.runId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, kind, payload, weight, occurred_at AS occurredAt, run_id AS runId FROM transcript_entry WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
